cases.name: Derricka Sheunda Body
cases.about: Her mother Regina Scott said, "My daughter was a wonderful mother and a loving sister and friend to all that knew her, loved her personality, and she was loved by everyone.”
cases.narrative: (Her mother) Regina Scott said she returned home Friday night and knew something seemed off. Her door was unlocked and her daughter and her three kids weren’t there. That’s when she began checking her video doorbell camera. “I was sitting on my back checking my camera and I was going through it. Then I seen everybody running in. Then I seen the police. Then I seen them bringing a body out,” Scott said. The body belonged to her 31-year-old daughter, Derricka. Scott said on the video you hear her frightened 12-year-old granddaughter describing how her mother’s boyfriend, Christopher Harvey, shot Body as she and her 5-year-old brother watched.

cases.name: Sabrina Kay Carson
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Sabrina love the Lord and people and most of all life.Sabrina will be greatly missed as a mother a friend and sister. This world will not be the same Sabrina always had a word of encouragement and a smile on her face."

"I love Sabrina. That's my heart. I have five kids that I don't know how I'm going to break the news to them," said Brian Johnson, who told 11Alive Carson was his aunt. "She's just one of those people that will give you their shirt, literally give it to you off of her back. She didn't have much, but she'll give everything she got."
